snippet.title: Power Instinct 2 Gameplay (PlayStation,PSX,PS1)
snippet.description:
Subscribe for more game footage! https://www.youtube.com/user/TheMfarec

Power Instinct 2 Gameplay (PlayStation,PSX,PS1)

Player: MfaRec

Description:

Power Instinct 2 features five new characters, giving a total of 13 playable characters and one unplayable boss (Otane Goketsuji). The PlayStation version, was only released in Japan and unlike the arcade game, anytime a transformable character changed into his or her alternate version in the PlayStation port, there was considerable loading time that interrupted the match.

Platform: PlayStation
Release Date: April 1994
